mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_CODE "boardCode", BOARD_NAME "boardName" FROM BOARD_TYPE ORDER BY BOARD_CODE

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, MEMBER_NAME, BOARD_READ_COUNT , WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO AND COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N') COMMENT_COUNT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 --초단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 -- 분단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 -- 시간단위 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END BOARD_WRITE_DATE
FROM "BOARD" B LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND (BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL) AND BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_CODE, BOARD_READ_COUNT, bo.MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, TO_CHAR(BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24:MI:SS') BOARD_WRITE_DATE, TO_CHAR(BOARD_UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24:MI:SS') BOARD_UPDATE_DATE FROM "BOARD" bo LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" me ON(bo.MEMBER_NO=me.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" wo ON(bo.MEMBER_NO=WO.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" em ON(bo.MEMBER_NO=em.MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND (BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL) AND BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} AND BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}
SELECT SUBSTR(PROFILE_IMG, INSTR(PROFILE_IMG, '/', -1) +1 ) "rename" FROM "MEMBER" WHERE PROFILE_IMG IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CAST(IMG_RENAME AS VARCHAR2(300)) "rename" FROM "BOARD_IMG"

SELECT LEVEL, C.* FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COMMENT_NO_BOARD, COMMENT_CONTENT_BOARD, TO_CHAR(COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME , PARENT_COMMENT_NO, COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo}) C WHERE COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.COMMENT_NO_BOARD AND COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N') START WITH PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENT_NO_BOARD = PARENT_COMMENT_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY COMMENT_NO_BOARD

SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) COMMENT_COUNT,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60 ) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 ) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - BOARD_WRITE_DATE) * 24 ) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(BOARD_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END BOARD_WRITE_DATE
FROM "BOARD" B LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND (BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL) AND BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
AND BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( WORKER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%')
ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "BOARD"
LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO)
WHERE BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' AND BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}
AND BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( WORKER_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%')
